candidateTools.title: Commercial Continuous Atmospheric Cold Gaseous Ozone (O3) Conveyor In-Line Spore Sterilization & Off-Gas Destruction Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models continuous conveyor surface sanitization with high-concentration gaseous ozone (50-250 ppm), relative humidity activation kinetics (>80% RH), Clostridium and Aspergillus spore coat oxidation, and catalytic thermal ozone destruction under OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.1000.

candidateTools.title: Commercial Continuous Supercritical Fluid Chromatography (SFC) Industrial Cannabinoid & Bioactive Purification Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models continuous multi-column supercritical fluid chromatography (SFC) utilizing dense CO2 and ethanol co-solvent mobile phases at up to 350 bar, axial dispersion, peak resolution, and ASME BPVC Section VIII relief sizing for high-purity bioactive separation.

candidateTools.title: Commercial Continuous High-Frequency Microwave-Plasma In-Line Decontamination Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models continuous atmospheric pressure microwave-plasma jet (2.45 GHz, Ar/O2/N2 gas mixtures) rapid in-line packaging surface decontamination, active UV photonic radiation flux, hydroxyl radical generation kinetics, and heat-sensitive polymer surface functionalization without thermal deformation under FDA 21 CFR § 179.26.

candidateTools.title: Commercial Continuous Electrohydrodynamic (EHD) Non-Thermal Airflow Dehydration & Vitamin C Preservation Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models continuous high-voltage wire-to-plane corona discharge ionic wind (EHD) convection acceleration (ionic drift velocity > 3.5 m/s), low-temperature surface boundary layer disruption (20-35°C), zero-heat moisture evaporation kinetics, and ascorbic acid retention (>95%) for sensitive heat-labile fruits and enzymes.
